Summary: Redgum scheduling core (Sprint 1)
Description: Committed Sprint 1 epic: student/tutor records, tutor availability, session booking with the availability rule, and schedule views.

Summary: Parked product backlog
Description: Stakeholder requests explicitly parked out of Sprint 1 with reasons; kept visible for future planning per the case study.

Summary: RED-01 Project scaffold, configuration and CI
Description:
As a developer, I want a runnable, configured project scaffold with CI, so that the whole team builds on one working baseline.

Acceptance criteria:
- Application starts from a clean checkout following the README alone
- Environment-based configuration (dev/test/production) with .env.example
- GitHub Actions installs dependencies and runs pytest on push and pull requests
- No secrets, tokens, student IDs or real personal data in the repository

Story point justification: 5 = multi-layer feature touching routes, services and tests

Summary: RED-02 Data model and SQLite persistence
Description:
As a developer, I want students, tutors, availability windows and sessions persisted in SQLite, so that data survives application restarts.

Acceptance criteria:
- Schema for students, tutors, availability_windows and sessions with foreign keys
- Repository create/read/update functions with required-field validation
- CHECK constraints for statuses and 60/90 minute session lengths
- Repository tests demonstrate persistence across a new connection

Story point justification: 5 = multi-layer feature touching routes, services and tests

Summary: RED-03 Tutor availability domain rule with negative tests
Description:
As Deb (front desk), I want every proposed booking checked against the tutor's availability windows, so that sessions can never be booked when the tutor is unavailable.

Acceptance criteria:
- A slot is accepted only when it falls entirely inside one window for that weekday
- Starting exactly at window open or ending exactly at window close is accepted
- Bookings before open, after close, across a gap, on an unavailable day, or with a deactivated tutor are refused with a clear reason
- Automated positive and negative tests cover every case, including moved sessions

Story point justification: 5 = multi-layer feature touching routes, services and tests

Summary: RED-04 Student records: create, find, edit, deactivate
Description:
As Deb, I want to maintain student records with name, year, family contact and subjects, so that student information is correct and available in one place.

Acceptance criteria:
- Create a student with name, year level, family contact and subjects
- Missing required fields are named and the record is not saved
- Find and edit existing students; deactivate a student without deleting history
- Records persist after restart

Story point justification: 3 = small single-screen change

Summary: RED-05 Tutor records: create, find, edit, deactivate
Description:
As Deb, I want to maintain tutor records and deactivate tutors who leave, so that the tutor list stays current after tutor turnover.

Acceptance criteria:
- Create a tutor with name and subjects taught
- Find and edit tutors; deactivate a tutor
- Deactivated tutors keep historical sessions but disappear from new-booking options
- Required fields are validated and nothing invalid is saved

Story point justification: 3 = small single-screen change

Summary: RED-06 Maintain tutor availability windows
Description:
As Deb, I want to add, change and remove each tutor's weekly availability windows, so that bookings match what tutors agreed, including mid-term amendments.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add multiple windows per weekday with start and end times
- Windows can be removed (change = remove then re-add)
- Weekday 1-7 and HH:MM times validated; end must be after start
- Windows are shown with the tutor and used by booking validation

Story point justification: 3 = small single-screen change

Summary: RED-07 Book a session with availability check
Description:
As Deb, I want to book a session choosing student, tutor, date, start time and 60/90 minute length, so that a correct booking takes under a minute while a parent waits.

Acceptance criteria:
- Session saves with status booked and appears on that day's schedule
- Only active students and tutors can be selected; lengths limited to 60 or 90 minutes
- Bookings outside an availability window are refused with a plain-language reason
- Missing required fields are named and nothing is saved

Story point justification: 5 = multi-layer feature touching routes, services and tests

Summary: RED-08 Move, cancel and mark session status
Description:
As Deb, I want to reschedule or cancel a session and mark attendance, so that changes, cancellations and no-shows are reliably recorded.

Acceptance criteria:
- Moving a session re-checks the availability rule on the new slot
- Cancelling keeps the record visible with status cancelled
- Booked sessions can be marked attended or missed; cancelled sessions cannot
- Moving or cancelling one session never changes another session

Story point justification: 3 = small single-screen change

Summary: RED-09 Centre day and week schedule view
Description:
As Helen, I want to see the whole centre's sessions for a chosen day or week, so that she can judge tutor utilisation and the day at a glance.

Acceptance criteria:
- Choose a day or a week and list every session with student, tutor, subject, time, length and status
- Days with no sessions show an empty state, not an error
- View is usable at phone width without horizontal scrolling

Story point justification: 3 = small single-screen change

Summary: RED-10 Tutor upcoming and student history views
Description:
As a tutor and a parent, I want tutors see their own upcoming sessions and a student's past/future sessions are visible, so that tutors know their week and Deb answers parent questions immediately.

Acceptance criteria:
- Tutor view lists only that tutor's upcoming sessions, soonest first, with an empty state
- Student view lists past and future sessions in date order
- Cancelled sessions remain visible and are clearly marked

Story point justification: 3 = small single-screen change

Summary: RED-11 Load case-study seed data and complete mobile usability pass
Description:
As the team, I want the paper documents loaded as sample data and a phone-usable interface, so that demonstrations use realistic scenarios and tutors can use their phones.

Acceptance criteria:
- A single command loads tutors, windows, students and Week 5 sessions from Documents A-C
- Seeded data matches the case study (Tomas card, diary moves, Kai enrolment)
- Mobile walkthrough of the core booking flow completes within one minute; defects fixed or logged

Story point justification: 2 = small single-screen change

Summary: RED-12 Test plan, cases, traceability and compatibility/usability evidence
Description:
As the assessor, I want a complete test workbook and quality evidence, so that delivery quality is independently verifiable.

Acceptance criteria:
- Test scenarios, test cases, requirements traceability matrix and summary following the provided workbook example
- Every committed story traced to at least one positive and negative case
- Browser/device compatibility matrix and usability walkthrough evidence with screenshots
- Defect log with retesting; CI green; no critical defects open

Story point justification: 5 = multi-layer feature touching routes, services and tests

Acceptance criteria (future):

- Clashes, gaps and capacity rules enforced

Acceptance criteria (future):
